hooks.text: 多种科幻武器各自对应不同战斗流派，升级还能叠出连锁组合，并按清场、精准打击或护盾需求定制配装。
hooks.excerpt: Each weapon brings a distinct playstyle, and upgrades let you stack up devastating combos. Whether you prefer crowd-clearing firepower, targeted precision, or life-saving shields, you can tailor your loadout for maximum carnage (and maximum style).
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 四个世界的地图会持续变化，随机小Boss、远处补给和可选任务共同改变每次异星生存跑局。
hooks.excerpt: Fight your way through four distinct environments. The map always changes, and many dynamic elements will challenge the player during runs. Special mini bosses that spawn when you don't expect them. Supply drops with helpful loot will spawn in the distance. And Random Missions will force the player to complete optional objectives if they want to reap the reward.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 幸存者式弹幕战斗包裹在80年代复古科幻动作氛围中，并由Cartridge 87的脉冲感配乐强化基调。
hooks.excerpt: If you’re seeking a survivors-like experience with an 80s sci-fi action vibe, set to the pulsing beat of a soundtrack by Cartridge 87, this game sets itself apart from the pack.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
